title: We built an agentic investment system with Claude to see if frontier AI models could consistently beat the market
author: Western-Report6360
selftext:
We built BenchmarkAI to answer some fundamental questions regarding how AI could be applied to public market investing, such as:

* When given the proper guardrails, rules and governance, can frontier AI models reliably manage a stock portfolio and beat it's benchmark?
* Would the agents stick to the risk (volatility) limits we assign?
* Do the agents perform better if we let them rebalance their portfolios daily, weekly or monthly?
* How do the agents handle market shocks like the Iran war / oil shock? Do they gamble or hedge?
* How do the agents perform during sector rallies (like the semiconductor rally & pullback of 2026)? Do they ride the wave, reduce concentration, lock in gains, etc.?
* If we give the exact same instructions and guardrails to agentic teams, do they buy the same stocks?
* Which frontier AI models are best at investing?

We used Claude and Codex to build the entire system. Within it, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok each run their own investment teams. We set the rules & guardrails. The agents develop their own strategy, research companies, choose what to buy/sell and decide how much to put in each position. Every trade is tied to the company & market research, analysis and reasoning behind it.

We launched the first portfolio in December 2025. In October 2026, we launched the [BenchmarkAI Indexes](https://www.benchmarkai.app/indexes?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=research-launch-2026-11&utm_content=steven), which are a culmination of all the lessons we've learned over the past year on how to best leverage AI in public market investing. The 5 indexes are made up up 160 individual portfolios across different investment universes.

[](https://preview.redd.it/we-built-an-agentic-investment-system-with-claude-to-see-if-v0-f63drr6t8f2i1.png?width=1080&format=png&auto=webp&s=0e0ece030398e0b3cd42210e6b8738250643a2ab)

**How a rebalance works**

Market research runs daily. One agent per model covers the market, plus a second Grok agent focused on X. For each of those five reports, another agent looks for evidence the first one missed. Each model uses all ten reports to write a shared assessment for its portfolios.

[](https://preview.redd.it/we-built-an-agentic-investment-system-with-claude-to-see-if-v0-2p842qcb8f2i1.png?width=1080&format=png&auto=webp&s=d812b3d1bf3b80aa8e139c9fa743f45f8eb48997)

At month-end, each team reviews its portfolio and builds a watchlist. Code screens the candidates. Research agents dig into filings, financial statements, prices and news. The portfolio manager agent then decides what to buy, sell or keep. If a position breaks a rule, the code sends it back to the manager to fix. We timestamp the final decisions before the simulated trades take place.

The October rebalance took about 40 hours and 20,000 agent runs. The teams wrote more than 18,000 reports on roughly 1,300 companies because each team researches stocks for its own strategy.

**Leverage the free research for your own portfolio**

The research is free for personal use. Compare the four models on a stock, look up their trades, or dig into the experiments above. We publish case studies where the agents got things right and wrong. [Research library](https://www.benchmarkai.app/research?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=research-launch-2026-11&utm_content=steven)

Connect the MCP plugin to Claude or ChatGPT and your own agent can pull all the reports, research and reasoning behind every trade. Give it a CSV with your portfolio holdings and use the plugin to analyze your portfolio to callout risks our models are seeing, whether they bought/sold that ticker and why, etc. [Plugin installation guide](https://www.benchmarkai.app/agents/plugin/docs?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=research-launch-2026-11&utm_content=steven)
